about: SPEC-serum2 §14.1 (owner I). calib = t_ref(calib): ms of CPU per 1 s of audio for the calibration row (b) through tests/ref-p1 (golden harness scope, 8 voices, see serum-dsp.test.mjs calibRowB), median of 15 unloaded runs on the reference machine; node CPU gates scale their loads by calib / t(calib) measured in the same run. ipad: loads recorded with tests/bench.html (rows d–m; hard ceiling 0.6).

node.machine: Apple M4 Max, node v24.21.0, tests/bench-scenarios.mjs (looping sample rows, every timed run audible; worst = slowest quantum / its real time; q rows: slowest quantum of a live processor's first 1.5 s after a preset change), uncalibrated (= reference machine); after the M4 performance pass

before.about: the same machine and harness before the M4 performance pass (q rows with the 1.5 s window)

jsc.machine: Apple M4 Max, macOS JavaScriptCore shell (Safari's engine), the voice rows rendered as in measure() (offline processor, median of 5 × 1 s); not an iPad record; after the M4 performance pass (before: d 0.422, e 0.094, f 0.177, f' 0.152, g 0.098, g' 0.187, g" 0.395, h 0.062, h' 0.098; worst quantum g' 1.99 ms, g" 4.55 ms)
